title: Refund insurance premiums in one migration transaction
message:
Refund insurance premiums in one migration transaction

The Phase 21 refund claim and the policy reset were separate autocommit
statements, so an interrupted migration left a payable claim with its
policy still set, and the rerun or the boot refund paid it again.

title: Revoke a removed player's permits on stowed hulls
message:
Revoke a removed player's permits on stowed hulls

Permit pruning skipped every inactive hull, so another owner's stowed
hull kept the deleted player's helm permit in memory and wrote it back
at her next save, where a new character of that name would find it.

title: Save stowed hulls with the fleet
message:
Save stowed hulls with the fleet

A stowed hull was saved with active raised for one attempt; if that
save failed, save_all_vessels() skipped the inactive hull, so the
shutdown never retried and a reboot restored her pre-loss or pre-summons
state. The runtime and weapon saves now accept a stowed hull, and the
full save includes stowed hulls.

title: Mark a lost hull's insurance paid with the claim
message:
Mark a lost hull's insurance paid with the claim

The claim no longer consumed a policy, so a hull saved while sinking and
restored by a crash before her wreck was saved went down again and
queued a second claim. The claim transaction now sets the runtime
wreck_hull flag, which already means her insurance is spent.

title: Give a wreck no trade-in credit
message:
Give a wreck no trade-in credit

A lost hull's insurance already paid for her, so trading in the rebuilt
wreck for 90% of the replacement boat let an owner renew an insured
boat for a tenth of its price after every loss. The shipwrights now
give nothing for a wreck.

title: Satisfy clang-tidy and the master-only test database
message:
Satisfy clang-tidy and the master-only test database

Compare shipbuy's mode with an explicit != 0, and let the stowed-hull
removal test add the owner column that boot adds, since the CI test
database starts from the master schema alone.

title: Apply Phase 21 alone to a fresh master schema
message:
Apply Phase 21 alone to a fresh master schema

The premium refund reads ship_interiors.owner and insured_for, which
Phase 06 adds. Add them if missing so the migration job, which applies
each component to a bare master schema, can run it.

title: Give the campaign merchant room to arrive after the restart
message:
Give the campaign merchant room to arrive after the restart

The provisioner stages her 11 rooms south of the central port and watched
her for 45 seconds before the restart, which left about a room of margin:
when the weather let her sail faster she was restored inside the port room,
arrived before the next session began, and was still casting off at the
second shutdown. A 30-second watch leaves her a few rooms short.

title: Refund old insurance premiums once at boot
message:
Refund old insurance premiums once at boot

The refund ran on every schema check, at each purge and save; it belongs
with the boot load, after the ownership columns exist.

title: Keep an NPC pilot aboard a summoned hull and guard the trade-in
message:
Keep an NPC pilot aboard a summoned hull and guard the trade-in

A summons put everyone over the side, the hull's own NPC pilot too, so she
made port without a pilot; the pilot now stays aboard. A trade-in rebuilds
the interior, so it is refused while an NPC pilot is assigned, and it
releases loaded vehicles onto the dock first, as a purge does. A kill's and
a sale's crew experience are saved at once.

title: Count down every timed slot in the shared reload tick
message:
Count down every timed slot in the shared reload tick

vessel_reload_tick() skipped a slot without a catalogue weapon, so a bare
test weapon stopped reloading; every timed slot counts down again, and only
a catalogue weapon's weight tires the crew.

title: Document crew, repair, and loss in the vessel references
message:
Document crew, repair, and loss in the vessel references

VESSEL_SYSTEM.md gains a Crew, Repair and Loss (S5) section, the new
commands and tables, the S5 reloads, the duel harness's tiring crews, and
the current ship structure size; the deployment guide adds Phase 21; the
study records what S5 built and decided.

title: Trade the loss gate's boat in for its own listed warship design
message:
Trade the loss gate's boat in for its own listed warship design

The Starfall Bastion prototype is not for sale in the development
database, so the gate lists a temporary warship design, trades in for it,
and deletes both prototypes; the harness cleans up any 'Losscheck'
prototype a failed run leaves.

title: Launch the loss gate's boat at sea and summon her into the east dock
message:
Launch the loss gate's boat at sea and summon her into the east dock

The (-66, 92) seaport is not a port in this world, so the boat starts one
room west of the east Testing Dock, is summoned in, and takes her crew and
her trade-in there.

title: Launch the loss gate's boat at the seaport and summon her to the east dock
message:
Launch the loss gate's boat at the seaport and summon her to the east dock

A character at the (-66, 92) seaport does not stand in a port room for the
shipyard commands, so the east Testing Dock is the summoning shipyard.

title: Gate the wreck registry, summons, crew hiring, and trade-in in game
message:
Gate the wreck registry, summons, crew hiring, and trade-in in game

The damage gate's sunk warship now waits in the wreck registry as a boat;
the gate summons her to the harbor's east dock, where she makes port without
sails, and buys new ones. The new loss gate (test_vessel_loss_in_game.sh,
the tactical harness's --loss mode, the login helper's --vessel-loss-check)
has a mortal captain refused an able hand, hire a green one, pay the rename
fee, summon a boat from the seaport, and trade her in for the warship
design.

title: Document crew, repair, the wreck registry and summons in the vessel help
message:
Document crew, repair, the wreck registry and summons in the vessel help

SHIPHIRE covers experience, promotion, casualties, the renown gate and
stamina; SHIPREPAIR the stores, crew and character repairs, and dock
prices; the ownership topic trade-in, the rename fee, SHIPSUMMON, the wreck
registry and automatic insurance. SHIPINSURE is retired, reloads read 17
and 25.5 seconds, and SHIPLIST notes stowed hulls. The verifier keeps 89
keywords and checks four more passages.

title: Bind the lost hull's slot in the wreck cleanup queries
message:
Bind the lost hull's slot in the wreck cleanup queries

The SQL interpolation check refuses new formatted queries with data values;
the two row deletions in vessel_wreck_hull() now bind the fleet slot, and
the vessels_upgrades.c baseline drops to its five remaining sites.

title: Keep a lost hull's identity in the wreck registry and let owners summon hulls
message:
Keep a lost hull's identity in the wreck registry and let owners summon hulls

Decision D3 (3.3.7): a player's hull that goes down is rebuilt in her own
fleet slot as the cheapest boat the shipyard sells, stripped, without sails
unless an NPC sank a larger hull, and waits out of the world in the wreck
registry with her name, owner, crew (after casualties), cosmetics and
permits. Insurance is automatic: the class share of her value, 90% for an
NPC kill, nothing for a raft or a rebuilt wreck. shipinsure is retired and
active premiums are refunded as claims (boot and Phase 21 SQL).

shipsummon (3.3.9) calls a hull, or her wreck, to a shipyard for a tenth of a
gold piece per hull weight: she leaves at once with an empty hold and makes
port after Duris's passage time, doubled from the registry, even across a
reboot. Registry and summoned hulls are stowed: inactive, so contacts, ticks
and commands pass them by, with their fleet slot kept and counted toward the
owner's cap; shiplist and shippurge still see them, and a deleted player's
stowed hulls are purged.

shipbuy <id> trade rebuilds the owner's berthed hull as the new one for 90%
of her value, keeping what of her fit-out the new class takes; a rename
costs 10% of her value after the first christening. Phase 21 adds stowed,
wreck_hull and summon_due to ship_runtime_state.

title: Tire crews by their work and let them repair from a stock
message:
Tire crews by their work and let them repair from a stock

Crews have Duris stamina (3.3.5): 500 plus 100 a tier, spent at the
helm, on every shot and reload tick, and on repairs, resting 1.5 a tick
(four times that berthed or anchored); a deficit slows accel, turn and
reload and lowers the hit chance and the crash save.

Repair follows 3.3.6 in the new vessels_repair.c: a stock of the class
hull weight, refilled at the berth; crew repairs at Duris odds up to the
bosun's caps (sails and rudder below 40%, structure below 10%, plus the
bosun mod; never armor); shiprepair at sea is one Craft (woodworking)
patch, and at a shipyard it buys priced dock repairs with maintenance.
The old free shiprepair is gone, and refits no longer repair (L10).

The duel harness now reloads, rests and repairs through the production
code. Stamina lengthened the D2 median to 521 s, so reloads, D2's lever,
move from 20 s and 30 s to 17 s and 25.5 s: 1,000 duels give a 437 s
median, 636 s p95, 208 s minimum, and 0.7% draws, steady across seeds.

title: Train crews by experience and promote them at their floors
message:
Train crews by experience and promote them at their floors

Each hired position carries experience from its tier floor (3.3.5): kills,
rooms sailed, cargo sold, reloads and shots at a lock. Reaching the next
floor promotes the hand; a lost hull's crew gives up a share, never falling
below green. Until renown exists (S7) only staff hire able or veteran hands.
ship_crew_roster.experience is Phase 21.
